definition: a calm pool of sea water behind rocks
description: A drone shot that starts close on three women in bright swimsuits standing together on a small strip of white sand, then climbs and pulls back. As it rises, two enormous grey limestone walls come into the frame on the left and right, rising sheer out of the sea and closing in on the little beach so that it sits at the bottom of a narrow slot. Palms and thick green jungle spill over the top of the beach behind them. In front, a shallow turquoise lagoon with dark patches of reef stretches out between the two rock walls towards the open sea.
